title: A rare target in a large crowd
hook: Two stated cases: explore the prevalence behind a highly accurate alarm.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the prevalence behind a highly accurate alarm affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the prevalence behind a highly accurate alarm in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
